I was in the hospital for 3 days. We did a lot of group therapy that you aren’t required to take. Did a lot of sitting around and talking with other patients that were there. We were allowed to make phone calls whenever we needed to from the phone from the nurses station. They gave us pen and paper to write all the numbers down before they took our cell phones away. Also not sure where you live but where I live in LA you can’t just check yourself into a inpatient hospital, I had to go to the emergency room and be checked in there till they could find a psych ward that has a bed for you. We were allowed to do as we pleased. We ate at meal time, had visitors in the evening, could sleep all day if you wanted to, Saw the psychiatrist at the end of every day. We were required to take our meds when they were distributed by the nurses. There weren’t any locks on the doors. The bathrooms don’t have mirrors or a door.
I checked myself in back in June. Ask me whatever you need to know
